cells.judge_note: This profile keeps the speaker's order and words: it removes what speech leaves behind and punctuates. Content moved out of its place counts as a finding only when the move changes the meaning. An idea repeated in the same words may appear once with what its repeats added; an idea restated in other words is kept both times.

cells.name: lissage-libre
cells.judge_note: This profile is free in form on purpose: it may rephrase, split, merge or rewrite a sentence entirely, in the speaker's register and order. A sentence said in other words is normal cleaning, never a finding. Judge only whether the content, the proper nouns and technical terms, the direction of each statement and the hedges survived the rewriting.
